summary: The unit test suite (tests/matrix.bats) is well-designed with decent coverage of core requirements (matrix generation, include/exclude, max-size validation, error cases, stdin input) and would likely function correctly. However, the pipeline test suite (tests/workflow.bats) references three critical missing files that make integration testing impossible: the workflow file (.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml) and fixture files (fixtures/sample.json, fixtures/simple.json). The test code also contains a logical error (checking for fixtures/active.json in PROJECT_ROOT instead of the work directory). Without these files, the workflow structure tests, actionlint validation, and all act-based integration tests cannot execute. Only 2 of 10 test scenarios involve error-path verification; the rest test happy-path scenarios. The design patterns are sound (proper use of fixtures, helpers, caching, artifact creation), but the incomplete implementation significantly undermines trust in regression detection. The task explicitly required the workflow file and fixture files to be created; their absence means the agent did not fully complete the deliverables.
